column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt together.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy, 4–5 minutes, then mix in the bananas.
Mix in the eggs and vanilla, then add the dry ingredients and stir just until combined. Don't overmix.
Scoop the batter into the pan and spread it into an even layer.
Bake 55–65 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 20 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.
While still slightly warm, wrap in wax paper to keep it moist.
